newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China M2 to increase 26 pct in '96 - central banker.
newsitem.headline: China M2 to increase 26 pct in '96 - central banker.

text.p: Dai Xianglong, governor of the People's Bank of China, the central bank, said on Wednesday that China's total money supply would increase by about 26 percent in 1996.

"It is estimated that by the end of this year, the total money supply (M2), compared with last year, will increase by about 26 percent," Dai said in a dinner speech to the Hong Kong Association of Banks.
Dai pointed out that the figure was 3.7 percentage points lower than the average annual rate of increase in the eightth five-year plan (1991-1995).
